item.title: Redistricting plaintiffs sue Utah legislature again to block new three-judge panel law
item.description: Utah's ongoing redistricting battle has a new twist: the plaintiffs are suing the Utah legislature yet again, this time trying to block the new law that allows district court cases to move from a single district judge to a three-judge panel.
